ALL.why: Goldman Sachs lowering price target from $280 to $250 is relevant to momentum/valuation but does not signal catastrophe losses exceeding $2.5B in a quarter (the exit condition). The thesis acknowledges weak recent price momentum; this downgrade reinforces that but doesn't trigger the exit unless catastrophe underwriting losses materialize.

DAR.why: Announcement of Q3 2026 earnings release on October 29 is procedurally relevant but does not yet contain the actual results. The exit condition requires seeing Q3 operating margin below 10% or negative FI/DGD contribution shifts—neither are disclosed here. This is a pre-earnings watch flag.

DLTR.why: Multiple mentions of Dollar Tree's strong valuation (EV-to-EBITDA highlight, analyst research reshuffles, bargain stock lists) are broadly supportive of the thesis but generic in tone. No Q3 EPS guidance cut below $0.80 is mentioned. These are general positive backdrop items, not decisive.

PARR.why: HF Sinclair commentary on elevated refining margins into 2027 and Jerry Stumbo's insider purchase ($2M) both support current strength. Refining crack spreads remain elevated (not fallen below $20/bbl exit threshold). Insider buying suggests confidence in the refining outlook.
